title: Division Algorithm for Polynomials — Polynomials
hook: Let's explore Division Algorithm for Polynomials from the chapter on Polynomials. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Division Algorithm for Polynomials If p(x) and g(x) are polynomials with g(x) ≠ 0, then p(x) = g(x)×q(x) + r(x) where degree(r) < degree(g). Used to find remaining zeroes. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Long division of polynomials: divide, multiply, subtract, bring down
💡 p(x) = g(x) × q(x) + r(x) — analogous to Euclid's lemma
💡 If two zeroes are known, divide to find quotient → remaining zeroes
💡 Verify: degree(quotient) = degree(p) − degree(g)
